text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "RailCom was established as part of the 1999 railways reform, which mainly sought to introduce free access to the railway network.", "gist": "RailCom was created during the 1999 railway reform to allow free access to the railway network."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Independent Complaints Authority for Radio and Television ICA", "gist": "ICA is the authority handling radio and TV complaints"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The Independent Complaints Authority for Radio and Television (ICA) handles complaints...", "gist": "ICA is responsible for handling complaints about radio and TV programmes"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The ICA seeks to determine possible breaches of the law in editorial broadcasts or unlawful refusal of the right to appear on a programme.", "gist": "ICA investigates potential legal violations in broadcasts or unlawful denial of appearance rights"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "However, the ombudsman service must be contacted to review the matter first, before a formal complaint can be filed with the ICA.", "gist": "Ombudsman review is required before filing a formal complaint with ICA"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Swiss Transportation Safety Investigation Board STSB", "gist": "STSB is the Swiss board for transportation safety investigations"}]}
